name: services/geo/building_index
description: Get the list of all buildings known to the institution.
brief_description: Get the list of all buildings.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector must contain subset of primary fields, which are described in the returns section of building2 method.

arguments.name: fac_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of faculty IDs. If given, then the result will contain only such buildings which are related to one of more of the given faculties.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: Unordered list of dictionaries. Each dictionary will contain a building description (as described in the building2 method) with the chosen fields.
